create_na_vit_model: create a NaViT model with variable-resolution image support using nested tensors for efficient batched inference
build_attention_module: build a multi-head attention module with QK layer normalization and scaled dot-product attention for transformer blocks
build_transformer_block: build a transformer block with stacked attention and feedforward layers using nested tensor compatibility
test_token_dropout: test variable-resolution image token dropout during training to reduce computation on high-resolution patches
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through NaViT with a list of different-resolution images and return classification logits
